notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
In the last 2 weeks we've released multiple little updates, here is a recap of what is being done:

Features:

 Rebalanced price of perks/abilities/slot
 Setting to change the background of the main menu (video/image)


Bug Fix:

 Fixed a spot where you can go outside of the arena
 Fixed connection with leaderboards
 Fixed some map artifacts

notes.title: Perks System Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We have completed the perks system and we are testing it right now, to get the right balance between prices and upgrades (and we are almost done!). We are going to publish a new trailer in a few days.
The update will be live very soon, so stay tuned!
Ah, here's the new logo:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40667111/6c39610dbbfbc45474519eb165ae3cf707953d8e.gif

Have a nice day and speak soon!

notes.title: Serenity Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Thanks to your feedbacks, we've just released an update to make things more balanced. The game is still challenging, but everything is way more enjoyable now.
Give it a try and let us know!
Looking forward to seeing you at the top of the leaderboard!
